description.en:
Basic Attack

Mortefi uses his dual pistols and flames to perform up to 4 consecutive shots, dealing Fusion DMG.

Heavy Attack

Mortefi enters the aiming state for a more powerful shot.
The aimed shot fired after charging finishes deals Fusion DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Mortefi consumes STA to perform consecutive shots at the target in mid-air, dealing Fusion DMG.

Dodge Counter

Use Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Mortefi menggunakan pistol ganda dan api untuk melakukan hingga 4 tembakan beruntun yang memberikan Fusion DMG.

Heavy Attack

Mortefi memasuki state membidik untuk tembakan yang lebih kuat.
Tembakan bidik yang dilepaskan setelah pengisian selesai memberikan Fusion DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Mortefi mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan tembakan beruntun ke target di udara, memberikan Fusion DMG.

Dodge Counter

Gunakan Basic Attack setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Fusion DMG.

description.en: Launch a flashing lightning of flames forward, dealing Fusion DMG.
description.id: Melontarkan kilatan petir api ke depan, memberikan Fusion DMG.

description.en:
Deal Fusion DMG, and apply Burning Rhapsody to all characters on the team.

Burning Rhapsody

When the active character's Basic Attack hits the target, Mortefi launches a Coordinated Attack, firing 1 Marcato.
When the active character's Heavy Attack hits the target, Mortefi launches a Coordinated Attack, firing 2 Marcato.
Mortefi can launch one Coordinated Attack every 0.35s.

Marcato

Deals Fusion DMG.
description.id:
Memberikan Fusion DMG, dan menerapkan Burning Rhapsody pada seluruh karakter tim.

Burning Rhapsody

Saat Basic Attack karakter aktif mengenai target, Mortefi melancarkan Coordinated Attack, menembakkan 1 Marcato.
Saat Heavy Attack karakter aktif mengenai target, Mortefi melancarkan Coordinated Attack, menembakkan 2 Marcato.
Mortefi dapat melancarkan satu Coordinated Attack setiap 0,35 dtk.

Marcato

Memberikan Fusion DMG.

description.en: After casting Resonance Skill Passionate Variation, the damage of Resonance Skill Fury Fugue is increased by 25% for 8s.
description.id: Setelah melancarkan Resonance Skill Passionate Variation, damage Resonance Skill Fury Fugue meningkat sebesar 25% selama 8 dtk.

description.en:
During Resonance Liberation Burning Rhapsody, each hit of Resonance Liberation Marcato will increase the DMG of the next Resonance Liberation Marcato by 1.5%, which can be triggered once every 0.35s, stacking up to 50 times.
The effect will be reset after Resonance Liberation Burning Rhapsody ends.
description.id:
Selama Resonance Liberation Burning Rhapsody, setiap hit Resonance Liberation Marcato akan meningkatkan DMG Resonance Liberation Marcato berikutnya sebesar 1,5%, yang dapat aktif sekali setiap 0,35 dtk, bertumpuk hingga 50 kali.
Efek ini akan di-reset setelah Resonance Liberation Burning Rhapsody berakhir.

description.en: Attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.

Resonance Skill: Fury Fugue

When Mortefi's Annoyance reaches 100, his Resonance Skill is replaced with Fury Fugue.
When casting Fury Fugue, Mortefi consumes all Annoyance to unleash high-speed flame lightning, dealing Fusion DMG, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.

Annoyance

Mortefi can hold up to 100 Annoyance and can restore Annoyance in the following ways:
- When Normal Attack Impromptu Show hits the target
- When Intro Skill Dissonance hits the target
- When Resonance Skill Passionate Variation hits the target
- Within 5s after casting Passionate Variation, Normal Attack Impromptu Show that hits the target restores Annoyance additionally.
description.id:
Resonance Skill: Fury Fugue

Saat Annoyance Mortefi mencapai 100, Resonance Skill-nya digantikan oleh Fury Fugue.
Saat melancarkan Fury Fugue, Mortefi mengonsumsi seluruh Annoyance untuk melepaskan petir api berkecepatan tinggi, memberikan Fusion DMG, dianggap sebagai Resonance Skill DMG.

Annoyance

Mortefi dapat menyimpan hingga 100 Annoyance dan dapat memulihkan Annoyance dengan cara berikut:
- Saat Normal Attack Impromptu Show mengenai target
- Saat Intro Skill Dissonance mengenai target
- Saat Resonance Skill Passionate Variation mengenai target
- Dalam 5 dtk setelah melancarkan Passionate Variation, Normal Attack Impromptu Show yang mengenai target memulihkan tambahan Annoyance.

description.en: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.
description.id: Berpeluang menghasilkan hidangan spesial saat memasak.

description.en: The incoming Resonator gains 38% Heavy Attack DMG Amplification for 14s or until they are switched out.
description.id: Resonator yang masuk mendapat 38% Heavy Attack DMG Amplification selama 14 dtk atau hingga diganti keluar.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

description.en: During Resonance Liberation Burning Rhapsody, Mortefi launches Coordinated Attacks when the on-field character performs their Resonance Skills, firing 2 Resonance Liberation's Marcato hits, dealing Fusion DMG.
description.id: Selama Resonance Liberation Burning Rhapsody, Mortefi melancarkan Coordinated Attack saat karakter di lapangan menggunakan Resonance Skill, menembakkan 2 hit Marcato Resonance Liberation yang memberikan Fusion DMG.

description.en: After using the Echo Skill, Mortefi restores an additional 10 Resonance Energy. This can be triggered once every 20 second.
description.id: Setelah menggunakan Echo Skill, Mortefi memulihkan tambahan 10 Resonance Energy. Efek ini dapat aktif sekali setiap 20 dtk.

description.en: During Resonance Liberation Burning Rhapsody, the Crit. DMG of Resonance Liberation's Marcato is increased by 30%.
description.id: Selama Resonance Liberation Burning Rhapsody, Crit. DMG Marcato Resonance Liberation meningkat sebesar 30%.

description.en: The duration of Resonance Liberation Burning Rhapsody is extended by 7s.
description.id: Durasi Resonance Liberation Burning Rhapsody diperpanjang 7 dtk.

description.en: When Resonance Skill Passionate Variation or Resonance Skill Fury Fugue hits a target, Coordinated Attacks will be triggered to fire 4 Resonance Liberation's Marcato hit(s), dealing Fusion Damage. DMG of Resonance Liberation's Marcato fired in this way is reduced by 50%.
description.id: Saat Resonance Skill Passionate Variation atau Resonance Skill Fury Fugue mengenai target, Coordinated Attack akan dipicu untuk menembakkan 4 hit Marcato Resonance Liberation, memberikan Fusion DMG. DMG Marcato Resonance Liberation yang ditembakkan dengan cara ini berkurang sebesar 50%.

description.en: When Resonance Liberation Violent Finale is cast, ATK of all team members is increased by 20% for 20s.
description.id: Saat Resonance Liberation Violent Finale dilancarkan, ATK seluruh anggota tim meningkat sebesar 20% selama 20 dtk.
